name: RC17-H1r: Single-Pass Residual MLP + afCRPS (no ODE)
theory: AIFS-CRPS/CRPS-LAM pattern: single forward pass from (noise, condition) to residual, trained with afCRPS on combined output. No ODE — residuals are direct network output. afCRPS gradient flows through one MLP evaluation, not 8 ODE steps. Proven at ECMWF operational scale.
target: CI worst_cell > 0.65. Spread-skill ratio closer to 1.0 than 154b.
falsification: After 200 epochs: CI < 0.55 (no improvement over 154b). afCRPS on single-pass residual has same spread as CFM.
diagnostic_plan: A1. Per-window CI at h=1, h=15, h=30
A2. Per-cell CI grid (5x5) — OTM moneyness gradient
A3. Spread-skill ratio per-horizon
A4. Bias vs spread decomposition (r values)
B1. KS daily per-cell vs 153a (23/25)
B2. Kurtosis per-horizon
B3. PC1-PC5 alignment
B4. Cross-cell correlation Frobenius
C1. afCRPS loss convergence curve
C2. Accuracy term vs diversity term over training
D1. Noise→residual per-cell diversity
D2. Cross-cell correlation of noise-induced variation
E1. Cross-model table: 153a/154b/154c/new
E2. Suite-by-suite comparison
F1. CI improvement: spread vs bias contribution
F2. If quality degraded: which component first? At which epoch?
F3. Most interesting finding (Nanda Q3)
learn_from_failure: If afCRPS doesn't improve CI over CFM-trained 154b: issue is ARCHITECTURE (MLP can't express calibrated spread), not loss. Confirms noise injection granularity (H3/H5) is the key.

name: RC17-H2r: Single-Pass Residual + afCRPS + VS Composite (no ODE)
theory: Lakatos proves VS > ES for correlation at high D. ES blind to correlation at D=750 (~27x weaker). Use per-cell afCRPS for marginals + per-frame VS for cross-cell (300 pairs/frame, already implemented). VS provides 300x more correlation gradient than ES.
target: CI comparable to H1r AND corr_ratio > 0.90.
falsification: After 200 epochs: correlation worse than H1r. VS adds cost without benefit.
diagnostic_plan: A1-A4: Same spread calibration as H1r
B1-B4: Same quality preservation
C1. afCRPS and VS convergence — do both terms decrease?
C2. Gradient magnitude: afCRPS vs VS — which dominates?
C3. Loss weight sensitivity: try 70%afCRPS+30%VS and 30%afCRPS+70%VS
D1-D2: Same noise propagation
E1-E2: Same cross-model comparison
F1. Does VS specifically improve Suite 9?
F2. Does VS hurt CI? (tradeoff)
F3. Per-frame VS contribution: which frames benefit?
learn_from_failure: If VS doesn't improve over H1r: single-pass MLP lacks spatial attention needed to learn from VS gradient. Points to H5 (factored attention) as necessary for correlation.

name: RC17-H3: ConditionalLayerNorm in Velocity Net + afCRPS (within FM)
theory: AIFS injects noise via CLN in ALL transformer layers. Multiplicative (gamma(z)*LayerNorm(x)+beta(z)), zero-init ((scale+1.0) formulation). Same noise across all ODE steps per member. Conditions the NETWORK, not velocity output. 0.14% parameter overhead. Exact implementation verified from Anemoi source code.
target: CI worst_cell > 0.60. corr_ratio > 0.90. No explosion increase.
falsification: After 200 epochs: CI < 0.55 AND corr < 0.80. CLN in factored velocity net doesn't produce useful diversity.
diagnostic_plan: A1-A4: Spread calibration
B1-B4: Quality preservation
C1. afCRPS convergence
C2. Does model use noise? std of (scale-1) and bias across layers
C3. Which layers use noise most? Early vs late, temporal vs spatial
D1. Noise attenuation: ||output_noise - output_clean|| / ||noise||
D2. Per-member velocity field difference — K=8 members produce different velocities?
D3. Cross-cell correlation of member variation
D4. Per-cell spread from CLN — heterogeneous or uniform?
E1-E2: Cross-model comparison
F1. Does CLN noise accumulate beneficially through 8 ODE steps?
F2. Ablation: same noise across steps vs fresh noise per step
F3. Zero-init working? Plot scale/bias norms across epochs
learn_from_failure: If CLN in velocity net doesn't help: factored attention smooths CLN modulation across reshape. Incompatible with within-FM noise. Points to H5 (no ODE, direct generation) as only viable CLN path.

name: RC17-H5: Factored Transformer + CLN + afCRPS (no ODE, direct generation)
theory: Synthesis of proven components. Factored attention = cross-cell correlation (153a corr=1.001). CLN noise = preserved diversity through attention (Latte TMLR 2025 validates in factored attention with independent adaLN per block). afCRPS = calibrated spread (133c CI=91.7%). No ODE — single-pass: (condition, noise_z) → future surface. Each attention block has its own CLN recomputed from noise (Latte design). Noise is 32-dim global vector (FGN design).
target: CI worst_cell > 0.80 AND corr_ratio > 0.80 AND kurtosis 0.5-2.0. 6+/9 suites.
diagnostic_plan: A1-A4: Spread calibration (PRIMARY target)
B1. KS daily — does no-ODE generation preserve daily changes?
B2. Kurtosis — 133c got 1.60 with additive noise. CLN should match or beat
B3. PC1-PC5 alignment
B4. Cross-cell correlation — THE key. 133c=0.087 (additive), 153a=1.001 (no noise). CLN target: >0.80
C1. afCRPS convergence without ODE — stable?
C2. Noise dim ablation: 16, 32, 64
C3. Member diversity: K=8 outputs — how different?
D1. CLN scale/bias per block: temporal vs spatial attention usage
D2. KEY: if spatial CLN scale ≈ 0 → spatial attention ignores noise → cells independent (133c failure)
D3. Ablation: CLN in spatial only vs temporal only vs both
D4. Cross-cell noise correlation matrix — compare with GT correlation
E1. Cross-model: 133c / 153a / 154b / H5
E2. Suite comparison with 152b (AR flow, 5/9)
E3. Multi-seed (s42/43/44) if 5+ suites
E4. Long-horizon 252d if 5+ suites
F1. WHY does CLN preserve/destroy correlation? Mechanistic + numbers
F2. Spread-skill ratio — calibrated or over/under-dispersive?
F3. Most interesting finding (Nanda Q3)
F4. Does H5 make FM-based approaches obsolete? Or complementary?

learn_from_failure.low_ci_high_corr: CLN noise too subtle. Try larger noise_dim or remove zero-init.
learn_from_failure.high_ci_low_corr: Same as 133c — CLN doesn't enforce correlation in factored attention. Try full attention + CLN.
learn_from_failure.both_low: afCRPS suppresses diversity even with CLN. Different training recipe needed (CFM pretrain → afCRPS fine-tune).
learn_from_failure.training_unstable: afCRPS + CLN has optimization issues. Two-phase training like SDL.
